GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When qst re the tempo throughout, rdr std instructed to ride mnt in a comfortable pos, however, not to allow his mnt to come off the bit. Added when a runner was established to his outside in the early stages, the tempo quickened and bearing in mind his instructions he did not want to overly restrain his mnt as he believed he was travelling in a comfortable pos. He further added that due to the heavy impost, his mnt was unable to retain a finishing effort. Stewards noted explanation. Rdr was reminded of his obligations to ride his mnts out fully to the end of the race.
